# 共享国策：仿 congo_shared.txt（顶层定义）+ belgium.txt（裸引用）的写法

shared_focus = {
	id = SH_base
	icon = GFX_goal_generic_army
	x = 0
	y = 0
	cost = 5
}

shared_focus = {
	id = SH_child
	icon = GFX_goal_generic_army
	relative_position_id = SH_base
	x = -2
	y = 2
	prerequisite = { focus = SH_base }
}

# 引用上面两个共享国策的树
focus_tree = {
	id = host_tree

	shared_focus = SH_base
	shared_focus = SH_child

	focus = {
		id = H_own
		x = 3
		y = 0
		prerequisite = { focus = SH_child }
	}
}
